text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As I'm walking around the academy,<n>Symboli
Rudolf spots me and<n>approaches.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah, perfect timing. I was just hoping<n>to speak with
you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
A matter has arisen that requires the<n>student
council's attention. It seems<n>we need all hands on
deck.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Would you mind if I missed today's<n>training
session to attend to it?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I shall ensure that it is dealt with by<n>the end of the
day, so future sessions<n>should be unaffected—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hold it right there, bucko!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Teio?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: You need a hand, right? Well, I've got<n>two!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate your enthusiasm, but this<n>is a matter
for the student council.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: C'mooon, I just wanna help out!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I won't mess around! I pinky swear!
choice_data_list: Many hands make light work, right?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I should be enough to make<n>up the
difference.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
No way! Awww, so much for<n>Operation Get
Praised...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Fine, you win! But next time, I won't<n>take no for an
answer!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I am flattered enough that you asked.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Teio.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Urgh...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I'm needed in the student<n>council office.
I'll see you tomorrow,<n>Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
True to her word, Symboli Rudolf<n>attends to her
duties with lightning<n>speed. By the end of the day,
she has<n>finished everything.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yeah, exactly! See? It's a great idea!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Just think about it! The harder I work,<n>the quicker
you can get back to<n>training!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I have to say, I did not foresee my<n>own trainer
taking Teio's side.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Very well, then. But I expect you to<n>follow my
instructions to the letter.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yahoo! You got it, Prez! To the letter!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yeaaah, I'm gonna be rolling incompliments! ♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Well then, if you'll excuse us, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! ♪ I'm Prez's little helper! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
In the end, Symboli Rudolf manages to<n>clear her
student council workload by<n>the end of the day.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
This is thanks in no small part to<n>Tokai Teio
following instructions<n>carefully, lightening the load
on<n>Symboli Rudolf's shoulders.
